## Built for business. Trusted by IT. Ready for AI.

Intelligent enterprises connect data, analytics, and AI across operations for faster, smarter
decisions. Ready to make the leap?

Alteryx One offers a clear path:


**Give teams an easy way to use enterprise data and AI while IT keeps control over security, scale,
and governance.**


**Reduce manual data prep time by up to 90%, automate analytics, and embed AI across the business.**


**Turn those data-backed decisions into impact with low-/no-code tools, AI assistance, and built-in
governance.**

[Discover Alteryx One][215]
Decision intelligence
Insights that drive action
Meaningful, measurable results
 
 

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

“What took my team almost a year to complete is now replicable and done in a matter of weeks.”

— Nikita Atkins, Data Science Global Leader, GHD

[ Start Now ][220]
 

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

Put data and AI to work for you. Connect systems, prep and blend data [**up to 100x faster**][221],
automate repeatable work, and keep lineage and controls in place. Alteryx One is a full-spectrum
analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Act

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

 

[Discover Alteryx One][222]

### Data integration and AI-ready preparation

Create a unified view out of ERPs, CRMs, lakes, and files. Alteryx lets you connect enterprise apps
like Oracle and Microsoft without copying data. Automate prep with low-/no-code workflows, add
business context, and enforce governance and lineage to publish AI-ready datasets. Benefits include:
* Improved accuracy
* Faster analysis
* A single source of truth for teams

[Prepare Your Data][223]

## Built for business. Trusted by IT. Ready for AI.

Intelligent enterprises connect data, analytics, and AI across operations for faster, smarter
decisions. Ready to make the leap?

Alteryx One offers a clear path:


**Give teams an easy way to use enterprise data and AI while IT keeps control over security, scale,
and governance.**


**Reduce manual data prep time by up to 90%, automate analytics, and embed AI across the business.**


**Turn those data-backed decisions into impact with low-/no-code tools, AI assistance, and built-in
governance.**

[Discover Alteryx One][215]
Decision intelligence
Insights that drive action
Meaningful, measurable results
 
 

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

“What took my team almost a year to complete is now replicable and done in a matter of weeks.”

— Nikita Atkins, Data Science Global Leader, GHD

[ Start Now ][220]
 

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

Put data and AI to work for you. Connect systems, prep and blend data [**up to 100x faster**][221],
automate repeatable work, and keep lineage and controls in place. Alteryx One is a full-spectrum
analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Act

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

 

[Discover Alteryx One][222]

### Data integration and AI-ready preparation

Create a unified view out of ERPs, CRMs, lakes, and files. Alteryx lets you connect enterprise apps
like Oracle and Microsoft without copying data. Automate prep with low-/no-code workflows, add
business context, and enforce governance and lineage to publish AI-ready datasets. Benefits include:
* Improved accuracy
* Faster analysis
* A single source of truth for teams

# You’ve staffed up.
# You’ve bought the GPUs.

The hard part? Making agentic AI work in the enterprise. That’s where we come in.

[ Try it ][113] [ Request a demo ][114]
DataRobot is a 3X Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Data Science and Machine Learning
Platforms
[ Read the report ][115]
[datarobot logo purple] [gartner logo]

Meet the only agent workforce platform built for outcomes — not endless pilots.

Replace 50+ AI tools.
Launch your first agent in days, not quarters.
Run anywhere. On-prem. Hybrid. Cross-cloud.

## Deliberately designed to **unify complex enterprise environments**

### Foundational agents

Agents that are easy to stand up to and infuse into your organization’s specific processes and
systems.
[

### Business agents

Integrations, data models and UIs that make it easy to build and integrate your own agents into your
SAP tools.
[homepage sap logo]
Co-developed for SAP
The exclusive agentic AI partner fully certified
to run inside the SAP ecosystem.
][116]

### Purpose-built agents

Service-led delivery of agents, built and managed by DataRobot, to help you quickly create a full
agentic workforce.
[

### Agent Workforce Platform

The *only* end-to-end agent workforce platform for secure, scalable, production-grade agents.
[homepage nvidia logo]
Co-engineered with NVIDIA
The Agent Workforce Platform fully validated
and embedded in the NVIDIA Enterprise AI.
][117]

## With DataRobot, your agents
## **go beyond the demo.**

## One agent platform. For every team.
## **Built to power each phase of your agent lifecycle.**

### Teams that **build** agents

Build enterprise-grade agents on your terms.
* Build faster with customizable blueprints and built-in integrations — in your dev environment or
  ours.
* From LLMs to embeddings, select the right components for your data and use case to build agents
  that are purpose-built, not pieced together.
* Find the [optimal balance][118] between accuracy, latency, and cost to deliver agents that hold up
  in production.

[homepage build]

### Teams that **operate** agents

Keep your agents running safely and securely.
* Orchestrate compute dynamically to [deploy agents anywhere][119] — edge, cloud, or on-prem.
* Monitor agent quality and mitigate issues in real time to ensure safe, reliable performance.
* Authenticate agents and users to control access to your data and APIs.

[homepage operate]

### Teams that **govern** agents

No rogue agents. No blind spots. No surprises.
* Track every asset and activity across the agent lifecycle to maintain global visibility and
  control over what’s running where.
* Define enforceable controls — from access to approvals — to meet enterprise and industry
  compliance requirements.
* Use testing frameworks and automated audit documentation to detect behavior issues before they put
  your business at risk.

[homepage govern]

## DataRobot is honored **to be
## recognized by industry leaders**

### Multiyear leader in the Magic Quadrant™ for
### DSML Platforms and Customers’ Choice

[homepage gartner logo]
[Pattern]

### Recognized in MarketScapes for
### AI Governance and ML Operations

[homepage idc logo]
[Pattern]

### Featured in the Forbes Cloud 100
### and AI 50 across multiple years

[homepage forbes logo]
[Pattern]

### Named to Fortune’s Future 50 list for AI innovation

[homepage fortune logo]
[Pattern]

## Don’t take our word for it

“Enterprise IT teams are seeking best practices for integrating AI agents into their infrastructure
to transform productivity. DataRobot’s inclusion with the NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory reference
design provides an ideal solution for deploying AI agents with the essential monitoring,
guardrailing and orchestration capabilities needed for production AI.”

John Fanelli
Vice President, Enterprise Software at NVIDIA
[homepage validation 1]
World’s largest consumer tech brand

### $60M ROI

50+ AI use cases covering full supply chain,
from procurement to shipment

“The main thing that DataRobot brings for my team is the ability to iterate quickly. We can try new
things, put them into production fast, and adjust based on real-world feedback. That flexibility is
key — especially when you’re working with legacy systems like we are.”

Ben DuBois
Director, Data Analytics at Norfolk Iron & Metal
[homepage validation 2]
Global energy innovator

### $200M ROI

600+ AI use cases from stuck pipe
detection to well performance

“The platform made it easy to bring together data across Snowflake, SQL, and S3 — and helped us
automate and accelerate the entire forecasting process.”

Venkatesh Sekar
Enterprise Architect: AI/ML at NetAPP
[homepage validation 3]
Top 5 global bank

### $70M ROI

40+ AI use cases firm-wide, from capital
markets to wealth management

Meet the only agent workforce platform built for outcomes — not endless pilots.

Replace 50+ AI tools.
Launch your first agent in days, not quarters.
Run anywhere. On-prem. Hybrid. Cross-cloud.

## Deliberately designed to **unify complex enterprise environments**

### Foundational agents

Agents that are easy to stand up to and infuse into your organization’s specific processes and
systems.
[

### Business agents

Integrations, data models and UIs that make it easy to build and integrate your own agents into your
SAP tools.
[homepage sap logo]
Co-developed for SAP
The exclusive agentic AI partner fully certified
to run inside the SAP ecosystem.
][116]

### Purpose-built agents

Service-led delivery of agents, built and managed by DataRobot, to help you quickly create a full
agentic workforce.
[

### Agent Workforce Platform

The *only* end-to-end agent workforce platform for secure, scalable, production-grade agents.
[homepage nvidia logo]
Co-engineered with NVIDIA
The Agent Workforce Platform fully validated
and embedded in the NVIDIA Enterprise AI.
][117]

## With DataRobot, your agents
## **go beyond the demo.**

## One agent platform. For every team.
## **Built to power each phase of your agent lifecycle.**

### Teams that **build** agents

Build enterprise-grade agents on your terms.
* Build faster with customizable blueprints and built-in integrations — in your dev environment or
  ours.
* From LLMs to embeddings, select the right components for your data and use case to build agents
  that are purpose-built, not pieced together.
* Find the [optimal balance][118] between accuracy, latency, and cost to deliver agents that hold up
  in production.

[homepage build]

### Teams that **operate** agents

Keep your agents running safely and securely.
* Orchestrate compute dynamically to [deploy agents anywhere][119] — edge, cloud, or on-prem.
* Monitor agent quality and mitigate issues in real time to ensure safe, reliable performance.
* Authenticate agents and users to control access to your data and APIs.

[homepage operate]

### Teams that **govern** agents

No rogue agents. No blind spots. No surprises.
* Track every asset and activity across the agent lifecycle to maintain global visibility and
  control over what’s running where.
* Define enforceable controls — from access to approvals — to meet enterprise and industry
  compliance requirements.
* Use testing frameworks and automated audit documentation to detect behavior issues before they put
  your business at risk.

[homepage govern]

### This is a node. Nodes perform discrete actions on data.

Like access, read, transform, merge, split, learn, predict, write, visualize.

### Connect nodes together to create a workflow.

Workflows depict sequential steps performed on data from left to right.

### You decide when to run your workflow.

Run the workflow node by node, in segments, or all at once. Re-run any time.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like clean and filter.

For example, looking at customer data from a specific region.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform a simple analysis.

For example, comparing budget vs. actual spend.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform an advanced analysis.

For example, using a decision tree for understanding churn.

### …and more.

e.g. geospatial analysis, image analysis, deep learning, generative AI, and much more.

Start with any data science experience and level up over time.

# Rapidminer

Leverage Rapidminer's portfolio to unify data preparation, machine learning, knowledge graphs, GenAI
and agentic AI. Connect data with business context to build, govern and scale trusted AI solutions
with explainable insights and enterprise-ready automation.

[Contact us][4]

### Intelligence Center X

Intelligence Center X includes key elements of the Rapidminer portfolio, powering the next phase of
industrial AI.

[Discover more][5]

## Introduction

Rapidminer is a powerful enterprise AI and analytics solution. It connects siloed data, uncovers
hidden insights and accelerates innovation through advanced analytics and AI automation. Flexible
and scalable, it empowers organizations to modernize existing systems while embracing
next-generation technologies like generative AI and AI agents.
* Break down data silos by unifying disparate sources.
* Activate "dark data" locked in reports and PDFs.
* Maximize investments by running existing SAS language code.
* Resolve complex questions through a unified knowledge graph.
* Deliver intuitive analytics tools that turn data into strategic advantage and enhance enterprise
  decision-making.

[A women working at a computer in a modern open-plan office, with monitors, keyboard, and colleagues
in background.]

## Why Rapidminer?

What sets us apart.

### One portfolio. Every layer of enterprise AI

Knowledge graphs, machine learning and agentic applications — all working together, not in silos.

### AI that's trusted, explainable and built on your data

Every insight traces back to source data. Every model is auditable. Decisions are defensible, not
just fast.

### Enterprise-proven. Built to last. Built to scale.

Production-hardened for the complexity of real enterprise environments — with the depth and
longevity to grow with your business.

Equip your organization to operationalize AI at scale. Rapidminer software provides the foundation
to add context to data, automate intelligently and deploy AI agents with confidence.

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## 30 Years of Pioneering Data

Trusted expertise at the intersection of human intelligence and AI innovation

1996
Early NLP Systems
Speech recognition and language processing — Appen's first steps in building human-labeled datasets
for AI.
2003
Search Relevance
Human evaluation for search quality at scale, powering the first generation of web search ranking
models.
2006
Machine Translation
Statistical translation models requiring multilingual human annotations across 100+ language pairs.
2012
AlexNet Era
Deep learning for computer vision — image annotation and bounding box labeling at industrial scale.
2017
Transformer Models
Attention mechanisms and BERT demanded high-quality sentence-level semantic understanding data.
2020
GPT-3
Large language model training required vast, carefully curated, diverse human-generated text
datasets.
2022
ChatGPT & RLHF
Human feedback alignment — our annotators trained reward models that shaped modern conversational
AI.
2024
Multimodal Foundation Models
Vision, language, and reasoning combined — powering the next generation of frontier AI systems.
2025
Agentic AI
Agentic AI went viral bringing scalable agents to local hardware.

AutoKeras: An AutoML system based on Keras. It is developed by [DATA Lab][49] at Texas A&M
University. The goal of AutoKeras is to make machine learning accessible to everyone.

## Learning resources
* A short example.

`import autokeras as ak

clf = ak.ImageClassifier()
clf.fit(x_train, y_train)
results = clf.predict(x_test)
`
* [Official website tutorials][50].
* The book of [*Automated Machine Learning in Action*][51].
* The LiveProjects of [*Image Classification with AutoKeras*][52].

[[drawing]][53]     [[drawing]][54]

## Installation

To install the package, please use the `pip` installation as follows:

`pip3 install autokeras
`

Please follow the [installation guide][55] for more details.

**Note:** Currently, AutoKeras is only compatible with **Python >= 3.7** and **TensorFlow >=
2.8.0**.

## Community

Ask your questions on our [GitHub Discussions][56].

## Contributing Code

Here is how we manage our project.

We pick the critical issues to work on from [GitHub issues][57]. They will be added to this
[Project][58]. Some of the issues will then be added to the [milestones][59], which are used to plan
for the releases.

Refer to our [Contributing Guide][60] to learn the best practices.

Thank all the contributors!

[[The contributors]][61]

## Cite this work

Haifeng Jin, François Chollet, Qingquan Song, and Xia Hu. "AutoKeras: An AutoML Library for Deep
Learning." *the Journal of machine Learning research* 6 (2023): 1-6. ([Download][62])

Biblatex entry:

`@article{JMLR:v24:20-1355,
  author  = {Haifeng Jin and François Chollet and Qingquan Song and Xia Hu},
  title   = {AutoKeras: An AutoML Library for Deep Learning},
  journal = {Journal of Machine Learning Research},
  year    = {2023},
  volume  = {24},
  number  = {6},
  pages   = {1--6},
  url     = {http://jmlr.org/papers/v24/20-1355.html}
}
`

## Acknowledgements

The authors gratefully acknowledge the D3M program of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency
(DARPA) administered through AFRL contract FA8750-17-2-0116; the Texas A&M College of Engineering,
and Texas A&M University.

# AutoML …

… provides methods and processes to
* make machine learning more accessible
* improve efficiency of machine learning systems
* accelerate research and AI application development

Machine learning (ML) has achieved considerable successes in recent years and an ever-growing number
of disciplines rely on it. However, this success crucially relies on human machine learning experts
to perform manual tasks. As the complexity of these tasks is often beyond non-ML-experts, the rapid
growth of machine learning applications has created a demand for off-the-shelf machine learning
methods that can be used easily and without expert knowledge. We call the resulting research area
that targets progressive automation of machine learning, [AutoML][86].

## Who we are

[Frank Hutter][87]
[Marius Lindauer][88]
[Katharina Eggensperger][89]

AutoML is a major topic in the machine learning community and beyond. To contribute to this field,
the academic research groups at the University of Freiburg, led by Prof. Frank Hutter, the Leibniz
University of Hannover, led by Prof. Marius Lindauer, and the University of Tübingen, led by Dr.
Katharina Eggensperger, develop new state-of-the-art approaches and open-source tools for topics
such as hyperparameter optimization, neural architecture search and dynamic algorithm configuration.
The first group was founded in 2013 by Prof. Hutter as an Emmy-Noether research group, where Prof.
Lindauer joined in 2014 as a postdoc, before founding his own group in 2019 in Hannover. In 2023,
Dr. Eggensperger, who did her Ph.D. under the supervision of Prof. Hutter and Prof. Lindauer,
founded her own early career research group at the University of Tübingen. A close collaboration
between the three groups allows the roughly [30 international researchers][90] to push the frontier
of AutoML. The groups raised a total of **4 ERC grants** (ERC Starting, Proof of Concept, and
Consolidator grants for Frank Hutter, and ERC Starting grant for Marius Lindauer), further public
funding from DFG, BMBF, BMWK, BMUV, as well as major funding from close collaborations with big and
small companies, such as Bosch and Aerzen.

You can learn more about us by visiting our university websites at [ML Freiburg][91], at [ML
Hannover][92] and at [AutoML for Sci

Machine learning (ML) has achieved considerable successes in recent years and an ever-growing number
of disciplines rely on it. However, this success crucially relies on human machine learning experts
to perform manual tasks. As the complexity of these tasks is often beyond non-ML-experts, the rapid

methods that can be used easily and without expert knowledge. We call the resulting research area
that targets progressive automation of machine learning, [AutoML][86].

[Frank Hutter][87]
[Marius Lindauer][88]
[Katharina Eggensperger][89]

AutoML is a major topic in the machine learning community and beyond. To contribute to this field,
the academic research groups at the University of Freiburg, led by Prof. Frank Hutter, the Leibniz
University of Hannover, led by Prof. Marius Lindauer, and the University of Tübingen, led by Dr.
Katharina Eggensperger, develop new state-of-the-art approaches and open-source tools for topics
such as hyperparameter optimization, neural architecture search and dynamic algorithm configuration.
The first group was founded in 2013 by Prof. Hutter as an Emmy-Noether research group, where Prof.
Lindauer joined in 2014 as a postdoc, before founding his own group in 2019 in Hannover. In 2023,
Dr. Eggensperger, who did her Ph.D. under the supervision of Prof. Hutter and Prof. Lindauer,
founded her own early career research group at the University of Tübingen. A close collaboration
between the three groups allows the roughly [30 international researchers][90] to push the frontier
of AutoML. The groups raised a total of **4 ERC grants** (ERC Starting, Proof of Concept, and
Consolidator grants for Frank Hutter, and ERC Starting grant for Marius Lindauer), further public
funding from DFG, BMBF, BMWK, BMUV, as well as major funding from close collaborations with big and
small companies, such as Bosch and Aerzen.

# Playing the Beer Game Using Reinforcement Learning

## The Classical Beer Game

The beer game is a widely used in-class game that is played in supply chain management classes to
demonstrate a phenomenon known as the bullwhip effect. The game consists of a serial supply chain
network with four players—a retailer, a wholesaler, a distributor, and a manufacturer.

[The agents of beer game]

In each period of the game, the retailer experiences a random demand from customers. Then the four
players each decide how much inventory of "beer" to order. The retailer orders from the wholesaler,
the wholesaler orders from the distributor, the distributor from the manufacturer, and the
manufacturer orders from an external supplier that is not a player in the game. If a player does not
have sufficient inventory to serve the current period's demand (or orders), the unmet demands are
backordered; that is, the customer or downstream node waits until inventory is available. The
manufacturer's supplier, however, never has shortages—it is assumed to have infinite supply. There
are deterministic transportation and information lead times, though the total lead time is
stochastic due to stockouts at upstream nodes. Each player may have nonzero shortage and holding
costs.


The players' goal is to minimize the total holding and shortage costs of the whole supply chain.
This is therefore a cooperative game, but the players are not allowed to communicate with one
another, and moreover they do not know the inventory levels or ordering decisions at the other
players—each player only has access to local information.


The beer game has been written about quite a bit in the academic literature. Most of this research
asks, **how do human players play the beer game?** and examines the bullwhip effect and other
phenomena that arise from this play. An important question that has not been addressed much in the
literature is, **how should players play the beer game?** In other words, what is the optimal
inventory policy that a given player should follow? This is a difficult question, especially when
the other players do not, themselves, follow an optimal policy. (The beer game can be classified as
a multi-agent, cooperative, decentralized, partially observed Markov decision process, a class of
problems that is known to be NEXP-complete—that is, very hard.)


Answering the question of how players should play will have implications not only for the beer game,
but also for optimizing inventory decisions in supply chains more generally.


## The Machine Learning Model

Our research addresses this question by developing a machine learning (ML) or artificial
intelligence (AI) agent to play the beer game.


We propose a modified Deep Q-Network (DQN) to solve to this problem. DQN has been used to solve
single-agent games (such as [Atari games][3]) and two-agent zero-sum games (such as [Go][4]).
However, the beer game is a cooperative, non-zero-sum game. Therefore, using DQN directly would
result in each player minimizing its own cost, ignoring the system-wide cost. To fix this issue, we
propose a feedback scheme that causes the agents to learn to minimize the whole cost of system. In
particular, we update the observed reward of each agent i in each period t using

in which we penalize the agent using the sum of the costs of the other agents. Therefore, the agents
learn to minimize the total cost of the system instead of just their own costs.


## How Well Does It Play the Game?

We present the results from a straightforward version of the game in which the DQN plays the role of
the wholesaler and the other three players each follow a base-stock policy. (A base-stock policy
means we always order to bring the inventory position—on-hand inventory minus backorders plus
on-order inventory—equal to a fixed value, called the base-stock level. A base-stock policy is known
to be optimal for the beer game, assuming all four players use it.) Each stage has a holding cost of
$2 per item per period. The retailer has a shortage cost of $2 per item per period and the other
stages do not have a shortage cost. The customer demand is either 0, 1, or 2 in each time period.

# Playing the Beer Game Using Reinforcement Learning

## The Classical Beer Game

The beer game is a widely used in-class game that is played in supply chain management classes to
demonstrate a phenomenon known as the bullwhip effect. The game consists of a serial supply chain
network with four players—a retailer, a wholesaler, a distributor, and a manufacturer.

[The agents of beer game]

In each period of the game, the retailer experiences a random demand from customers. Then the four
players each decide how much inventory of "beer" to order. The retailer orders from the wholesaler,
the wholesaler orders from the distributor, the distributor from the manufacturer, and the
manufacturer orders from an external supplier that is not a player in the game. If a player does not
have sufficient inventory to serve the current period's demand (or orders), the unmet demands are
backordered; that is, the customer or downstream node waits until inventory is available. The
manufacturer's supplier, however, never has shortages—it is assumed to have infinite supply. There
are deterministic transportation and information lead times, though the total lead time is
stochastic due to stockouts at upstream nodes. Each player may have nonzero shortage and holding
costs.


The players' goal is to minimize the total holding and shortage costs of the whole supply chain.
This is therefore a cooperative game, but the players are not allowed to communicate with one
another, and moreover they do not know the inventory levels or ordering decisions at the other
players—each player only has access to local information.


The beer game has been written about quite a bit in the academic literature. Most of this research
asks, **how do human players play the beer game?** and examines the bullwhip effect and other
phenomena that arise from this play. An important question that has not been addressed much in the
literature is, **how should players play the beer game?** In other words, what is the optimal
inventory policy that a given player should follow? This is a difficult question, especially when
the other players do not, themselves, follow an optimal policy. (The beer game can be classified as
a multi-agent, cooperative, decentralized, partially observed Markov decision process, a class of
problems that is known to be NEXP-complete—that is, very hard.)

but also for optimizing inventory decisions in supply chains more generally.

][140]
10 years of AlphaGo: The turning point for AI

Exactly one decade later, we look back at the match that sparked the modern AI revolution.

The future of intelligence

Demis shares his vision for the path to AGI - from solving "root node" problems in fusion energy and
material science to the rise of world models and simulations.

The arrival of AGI

Shane walks host Hannah Fry through his AGI framework, breaking down the levels from minimal AGI to
full AGI, and his timelines for each.

Google DeepMind robotics lab tour

Hannah interacts with a new set of robots—those that don't just see, but think, plan, and do.

AlphaFold: Grand challenge to Nobel Prize

Five years ago, AlphaFold 2 solved the protein structure prediction problem, unlocking new avenues
of biological research and providing our first major proof point that AI can be a powerful tool to
advance science and cure disease.

Het kan frustrerend zijn wanneer je team niet de juiste expertise heeft. Ondertussen willen

daalt. Daarnaast mis je cruciale inzichten om dit om te keren.

Betrouwbare Adviseur nodig

Stel je voor dat je een betrouwbare partner hebt die je projectmatig helpt en je organisatie naar
het volgende niveau te tilt. Wij staan voor je klaar met strategisch advies en betrouwbare
ondersteuning.
